title: Oozy Herbaceous Puffed Noodles
description: A festive Australian dish featuring pillowy egg noodles infused with herbs and spices, perfect for a light snack or appetizer.
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the chicken stock cubes with 2 liters of water and bring to a boil.
Add herbs (thyme, rosemary), saffron threads, salt, pepper, and lemon zest. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Slice the egg noodles into small pieces and add them to the pot along with the stock mixture. Cook for an additional 5-7 minutes or until tender.
Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly before serving hot.
For a crispy texture, preheat your air fryer or oven to 180°C/350°F. Drain the noodles and toss them with vegetable oil.
Place the noodle mixture on the tray in an evenly distributed layer and bake for 20 minutes at 160°C/320°F or until golden brown.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
